english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing something before anything else.

exampleSentences.english: Let’s eat first, then go shopping.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我哋先食飯，再去行街啦。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 sin1 sik6 faan6 zoi3 heoi3 haang4 gaai1 laa1

english.note: Use this when stressing that one action happens before another, rather than as a formal list marker.

exampleSentences.english: Firstly, let’s eat something, then go hiking.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我哋先食啲嘢，跟住先去行山。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 sin1 sik6 di1 je5 gan1 zyu6 sin1 heoi3 haang4 saan1
